Let me just guard on `__cpp_char8_t`. But some compilers also define `__cpp_char8_t` only in certain modes. Using the feature-test macro is the most correct.

The `pid_longitudinal_controller` currently performs delay compensation by estimating the drive distance of the vehicle after `delay_compensation_time` and looking at a future `TrajectoryPoint`, but slope compensation is applied using the pitch of the **current** trajectory point. On hilly roads, this mismatch in reference time can cause conflicts: the feed-forward term is computed for the future point while the slope compensation reflects the current position, producing undesired acceleration commands.

    Your goal is to align both compensations so they reference the same point in time/space. Specifically:

    1. Refactor the control pipeline so that delay compensation and slope compensation both operate on a point projected ahead on the trajectory by the estimated running distance during the delay.
    2. Support multiple slope sources:
       - `raw_pitch`: use the vehicle's measured pitch (current behavior when enabled).
       - `trajectory_pitch`: use the pitch from the trajectory at the delay-compensated future point.
       - `trajectory_adaptive`: use `raw_pitch` while the vehicle is stopped (or below a velocity threshold), and `trajectory_pitch` while moving above that threshold.
    3. Replace the existing boolean parameter `use_trajectory_for_pitch_calculation` with a `slope_source` string parameter and a `adaptive_trajectory_velocity_th` threshold parameter.
    4. Extend interpolation/utilities to work in 3D (including z) so that pitch can be derived from trajectory elevation, and add a helper to find a trajectory pose a given arc distance ahead of an index.
    5. Update the unit tests to cover the new return types, the 3D pitch calculation, and the new utility function.

    Use the future trajectory point for both the feed-forward target and the pitch value used in slope compensation so the two compensations are consistent.

## Implementation Plan
- Add a helper function `findTrajectoryPoseAfterDistance(src_idx, distance, trajectory)` in `longitudinal_controller_utils` that returns the interpolated pose at a given arc length along the trajectory from a source index.
    - Change `lerpTrajectoryPoint` to return a `std::pair<TrajectoryPoint, size_t>` (interpolated point + segment index) and interpolate the z coordinate as well.

36: bool isValidTrajectory(const Trajectory & traj)
37: {
38:   for (const auto & p : traj.points) {
39:     if (
40:       !isfinite(p.pose.position.x) || !isfinite(p.pose.position.y) ||
41:       !isfinite(p.pose.position.z) || !isfinite(p.pose.orientation.w) ||
42:       !isfinite(p.pose.orientation.x) || !isfinite(p.pose.orientation.y) ||
43:       !isfinite(p.pose.orientation.z) || !isfinite(p.longitudinal_velocity_mps) ||
44:       !isfinite(p.lateral_velocity_mps) || !isfinite(p.acceleration_mps2) ||
45:       !isfinite(p.heading_rate_rps)) {
46:       return false;
47:     }
48:   }
49: 
50:   // when trajectory is empty
51:   if (traj.points.empty()) {
52:     return false;
53:   }
54: 
55:   return true;
56: }
57: 
58: double calcStopDistance(
59:   const Pose & current_pose, const Trajectory & traj, const double max_dist, const double max_yaw)
60: {
61:   const auto stop_idx_opt = motion_utils::searchZeroVelocityIndex(traj.points);
62: 
63:   const size_t end_idx = stop_idx_opt ? *stop_idx_opt : traj.points.size() - 1;
64:   const size_t seg_idx = motion_utils::findFirstNearestSegmentIndexWithSoftConstraints(
65:     traj.points, current_pose, max_dist, max_yaw);
66:   const double signed_length_on_traj = motion_utils::calcSignedArcLength(
67:     traj.points, current_pose.position, seg_idx, traj.points.at(end_idx).pose.position,
68:     std::min(end_idx, traj.points.size() - 2));
69: 
70:   if (std::isnan(signed_length_on_traj)) {
71:     return 0.0;
72:   }
73:   return signed_length_on_traj;
74: }
75: 
76: double getPitchByPose(const Quaternion & quaternion_msg)
77: {
78:   double roll, pitch, yaw;
79:   tf2::Quaternion quaternion;
80:   tf2::fromMsg(quaternion_msg, quaternion);
81:   tf2::Matrix3x3{quaternion}.getRPY(roll, pitch, yaw);
82: 
83:   return pitch;
84: }
85: 
86: double getPitchByTraj(
87:   const Trajectory & trajectory, const size_t start_idx, const double wheel_base)
88: {
89:   // cannot calculate pitch
90:   if (trajectory.points.size() <= 1) {
91:     return 0.0;
92:   }
93: 
94:   const auto [prev_idx, next_idx] = [&]() {
95:     for (size_t i = start_idx + 1; i < trajectory.points.size(); ++i) {
96:       const double dist = tier4_autoware_utils::calcDistance3d(
97:         trajectory.points.at(start_idx), trajectory.points.at(i));
98:       if (dist > wheel_base) {
99:         // calculate pitch from trajectory between rear wheel (nearest) and front center (i)
100:         return std::make_pair(start_idx, i);
101:       }
102:     }
103:     // NOTE: The ego pose is close to the goal.
104:     return std::make_pair(
105:       std::min(start_idx, trajectory.points.size() - 2), trajectory.points.size() - 1);
106:   }();
107: 
108:   return tier4_autoware_utils::calcElevationAngle(
109:     trajectory.points.at(prev_idx).pose.position, trajectory.points.at(next_idx).pose.position);
110: }
111: 
112: Pose calcPoseAfterTimeDelay(
113:   const Pose & current_pose, const double delay_time, const double current_vel,
114:   const double current_acc)
115: {
116:   if (delay_time <= 0.0) {
117:     return current_pose;
118:   }
119: 
120:   // check time to stop
121:   const double time_to_stop = -current_vel / current_acc;
122: 
123:   const double delay_time_calculation =
124:     time_to_stop > 0.0 && time_to_stop < delay_time ? time_to_stop : delay_time;
125:   // simple linear prediction
126:   const double yaw = tf2::getYaw(current_pose.orientation);
127:   const double running_distance = delay_time_calculation * current_vel + 0.5 * current_acc *
128:                                                                            delay_time_calculation *
129:                                                                            delay_time_calculation;
130:   const double dx = running_distance * std::cos(yaw);
131:   const double dy = running_distance * std::sin(yaw);
132: 
133:   auto pred_pose = current_pose;
134:   pred_pose.position.x += dx;
135:   pred_pose.position.y += dy;
136:   return pred_pose;
137: }
138: 
139: double lerp(const double v_from, const double v_to, const double ratio)
140: {
141:   return v_from + (v_to - v_from) * ratio;
142: }
143: 
144: double applyDiffLimitFilter(
145:   const double input_val, const double prev_val, const double dt, const double max_val,
146:   const double min_val)
147: {
148:   const double diff_raw = (input_val - prev_val) / dt;
149:   const double diff = std::min(std::max(diff_raw, min_val), max_val);
150:   const double filtered_val = prev_val + diff * dt;
151:   return filtered_val;
152: }
153: 
154: double applyDiffLimitFilter(
155:   const double input_val, const double prev_val, const double dt, const double lim_val)
156: {
157:   const double max_val = std::fabs(lim_val);
158:   const double min_val = -max_val;
159:   return applyDiffLimitFilter(input_val, prev_val, dt, max_val, min_val);
160: }

162: geometry_msgs::msg::Pose findTrajectoryPoseAfterDistance(
163:   const size_t src_idx, const double distance,
164:   const autoware_auto_planning_msgs::msg::Trajectory & trajectory)
165: {
166:   double remain_dist = distance;
167:   geometry_msgs::msg::Pose p = trajectory.points.back().pose;
168:   for (size_t i = src_idx; i < trajectory.points.size() - 1; ++i) {
169:     const double dist = tier4_autoware_utils::calcDistance3d(
170:       trajectory.points.at(i).pose, trajectory.points.at(i + 1).pose);
171:     if (remain_dist < dist) {
172:       if (remain_dist <= 0.0) {
173:         return trajectory.points.at(i).pose;
174:       }
175:       double ratio = remain_dist / dist;
176:       const auto p0 = trajectory.points.at(i).pose;
177:       const auto p1 = trajectory.points.at(i + 1).pose;
178:       p = trajectory.points.at(i).pose;
179:       p.position.x = interpolation::lerp(p0.position.x, p1.position.x, ratio);
180:       p.position.y = interpolation::lerp(p0.position.y, p1.position.y, ratio);
181:       p.position.z = interpolation::lerp(p0.position.z, p1.position.z, ratio);
182:       p.orientation = interpolation::lerpOrientation(p0.orientation, p1.orientation, ratio);
183:       break;
184:     }
185:     remain_dist -= dist;
186:   }
187:   return p;
188: }

355:     update_param("stopped_jerk", p.jerk);
356:   }
357: 
358:   // emergency state
359:   {
360:     auto & p = m_emergency_state_params;
361:     update_param("emergency_vel", p.vel);
362:     update_param("emergency_acc", p.acc);
363:     update_param("emergency_jerk", p.jerk);
364:   }
365: 
366:   // acceleration limit
367:   update_param("min_acc", m_min_acc);
368: 
369:   // jerk limit
370:   update_param("max_jerk", m_max_jerk);
371:   update_param("min_jerk", m_min_jerk);
372: 
373:   // slope compensation
374:   update_param("max_pitch_rad", m_max_pitch_rad);
375:   update_param("min_pitch_rad", m_min_pitch_rad);
376:   update_param("adaptive_trajectory_velocity_th", m_adaptive_trajectory_velocity_th);
377: 
378:   rcl_interfaces::msg::SetParametersResult result;
379:   result.successful = true;
380:   result.reason = "success";
381:   return result;
382: }

390: trajectory_follower::LongitudinalOutput PidLongitudinalController::run(
391:   trajectory_follower::InputData const & input_data)
392: {
393:   // set input data
394:   setTrajectory(input_data.current_trajectory);
395:   setKinematicState(input_data.current_odometry);
396:   setCurrentAcceleration(input_data.current_accel);
397:   setCurrentOperationMode(input_data.current_operation_mode);
398: 
399:   // calculate current pose and control data
400:   geometry_msgs::msg::Pose current_pose = m_current_kinematic_state.pose.pose;
401: 
402:   const auto control_data = getControlData(current_pose);
403: 
404:   // self pose is far from trajectory
405:   if (control_data.is_far_from_trajectory) {
406:     if (m_enable_large_tracking_error_emergency) {
407:       m_control_state = ControlState::EMERGENCY;  // update control state
408:     }
409:     const Motion raw_ctrl_cmd = calcEmergencyCtrlCmd(control_data.dt);  // calculate control command
410:     m_prev_raw_ctrl_cmd = raw_ctrl_cmd;
411:     const auto cmd_msg =
412:       createCtrlCmdMsg(raw_ctrl_cmd, control_data.current_motion.vel);  // create control command
413:     publishDebugData(raw_ctrl_cmd, control_data);                       // publish debug data
414:     trajectory_follower::LongitudinalOutput output;
415:     output.control_cmd = cmd_msg;
416:     return output;
417:   }
418: 
419:   // update control state
420:   updateControlState(control_data);
421: 
422:   // calculate control command
423:   const Motion ctrl_cmd = calcCtrlCmd(control_data);
424: 
425:   // publish control command
426:   const auto cmd_msg = createCtrlCmdMsg(ctrl_cmd, control_data.current_motion.vel);
427:   trajectory_follower::LongitudinalOutput output;
428:   output.control_cmd = cmd_msg;
429: 
430:   // publish debug data
431:   publishDebugData(ctrl_cmd, control_data);
432: 
433:   // diagnostic
434:   diagnostic_updater_.force_update();
435: 
436:   return output;
437: }

439: PidLongitudinalController::ControlData PidLongitudinalController::getControlData(
440:   const geometry_msgs::msg::Pose & current_pose)
441: {
442:   ControlData control_data{};
443: 
444:   // dt
445:   control_data.dt = getDt();
446: 
447:   // current velocity and acceleration
448:   control_data.current_motion.vel = m_current_kinematic_state.twist.twist.linear.x;
449:   control_data.current_motion.acc = m_current_accel.accel.accel.linear.x;
450:   control_data.interpolated_traj = m_trajectory;
451: 
452:   // calculate the interpolated point and segment
453:   const auto current_interpolated_pose =
454:     calcInterpolatedTrajPointAndSegment(control_data.interpolated_traj, current_pose);
455: 
456:   // Insert the interpolated point
457:   control_data.interpolated_traj.points.insert(
458:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points.begin() + current_interpolated_pose.second + 1,
459:     current_interpolated_pose.first);
460:   control_data.nearest_idx = current_interpolated_pose.second + 1;
461:   control_data.target_idx = control_data.nearest_idx;
462:   const auto nearest_point = current_interpolated_pose.first;
463:   auto target_point = current_interpolated_pose.first;
464: 
465:   // check if the deviation is worth emergency
466:   m_diagnostic_data.trans_deviation =
467:     tier4_autoware_utils::calcDistance2d(current_interpolated_pose.first, current_pose);
468:   const bool is_dist_deviation_large =
469:     m_state_transition_params.emergency_state_traj_trans_dev < m_diagnostic_data.trans_deviation;
470:   m_diagnostic_data.rot_deviation = std::abs(tier4_autoware_utils::normalizeRadian(
471:     tf2::getYaw(current_interpolated_pose.first.pose.orientation) -
472:     tf2::getYaw(current_pose.orientation)));
473:   const bool is_yaw_deviation_large =
474:     m_state_transition_params.emergency_state_traj_rot_dev < m_diagnostic_data.rot_deviation;
475: 
476:   if (is_dist_deviation_large || is_yaw_deviation_large) {
477:     // return here if nearest index is not found
478:     control_data.is_far_from_trajectory = true;
479:     return control_data;
480:   }
481: 
482:   // Delay compensation - Calculate the distance we got, predicted velocity and predicted
483:   // acceleration after delay
484:   control_data.state_after_delay =
485:     predictedStateAfterDelay(control_data.current_motion, m_delay_compensation_time);
486: 
487:   // calculate the target motion for delay compensation
488:   constexpr double min_running_dist = 0.01;
489:   if (control_data.state_after_delay.running_distance > min_running_dist) {
490:     const auto target_pose = longitudinal_utils::findTrajectoryPoseAfterDistance(
491:       control_data.nearest_idx, control_data.state_after_delay.running_distance,
492:       control_data.interpolated_traj);
493:     const auto target_interpolated_point =
494:       calcInterpolatedTrajPointAndSegment(control_data.interpolated_traj, target_pose);
495:     control_data.target_idx = target_interpolated_point.second + 1;
496:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points.insert(
497:       control_data.interpolated_traj.points.begin() + control_data.target_idx,
498:       target_interpolated_point.first);
499:     target_point = target_interpolated_point.first;
500:   }
501: 
502:   // ==========================================================================================
503:   // NOTE: due to removeOverlapPoints(), the obtained control_data.target_idx and
504:   // control_data.nearest_idx may become invalid if the number of points decreased.
505:   // current API does not provide the way to check duplication beforehand and this function
506:   // does not tell how many/which index points were removed, so there is no way
507:   // to tell if our `control_data.target_idx` point still exists or removed.
508:   // ==========================================================================================
509:   // Remove overlapped points after inserting the interpolated points
510:   control_data.interpolated_traj.points =
511:     motion_utils::removeOverlapPoints(control_data.interpolated_traj.points);
512:   control_data.nearest_idx = motion_utils::findFirstNearestIndexWithSoftConstraints(
513:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points, nearest_point.pose, m_ego_nearest_dist_threshold,
514:     m_ego_nearest_yaw_threshold);
515:   control_data.target_idx = motion_utils::findFirstNearestIndexWithSoftConstraints(
516:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points, target_point.pose, m_ego_nearest_dist_threshold,
517:     m_ego_nearest_yaw_threshold);
518: 
519:   // send debug values
520:   m_debug_values.setValues(DebugValues::TYPE::PREDICTED_VEL, control_data.state_after_delay.vel);
521:   m_debug_values.setValues(
522:     DebugValues::TYPE::TARGET_VEL,
523:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points.at(control_data.target_idx).longitudinal_velocity_mps);
524: 
525:   // shift
526:   control_data.shift = getCurrentShift(control_data);
527:   if (control_data.shift != m_prev_shift) {
528:     m_pid_vel.reset();
529:   }
530:   m_prev_shift = control_data.shift;
531: 
532:   // distance to stopline
533:   control_data.stop_dist = longitudinal_utils::calcStopDistance(
534:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points.at(control_data.nearest_idx).pose,
535:     control_data.interpolated_traj, m_ego_nearest_dist_threshold, m_ego_nearest_yaw_threshold);
536: 
537:   // pitch
538:   // NOTE: getPitchByTraj() calculates the pitch angle as defined in
539:   // ../media/slope_definition.drawio.svg while getPitchByPose() is not, so `raw_pitch` is reversed
540:   const double raw_pitch = (-1.0) * longitudinal_utils::getPitchByPose(current_pose.orientation);
541:   const double traj_pitch = longitudinal_utils::getPitchByTraj(
542:     control_data.interpolated_traj, control_data.target_idx, m_wheel_base);
543: 
544:   if (m_slope_source == SlopeSource::RAW_PITCH) {
545:     control_data.slope_angle = m_lpf_pitch->filter(raw_pitch);
546:   } else if (m_slope_source == SlopeSource::TRAJECTORY_PITCH) {
547:     control_data.slope_angle = traj_pitch;
548:   } else if (m_slope_source == SlopeSource::TRAJECTORY_ADAPTIVE) {
549:     // if velocity is high, use target idx for slope, otherwise, use raw_pitch
550:     if (control_data.current_motion.vel > m_adaptive_trajectory_velocity_th) {
551:       control_data.slope_angle = traj_pitch;
552:       m_lpf_pitch->filter(raw_pitch);
553:     } else {
554:       control_data.slope_angle = m_lpf_pitch->filter(raw_pitch);
555:     }
556:   } else {
557:     RCLCPP_ERROR_THROTTLE(
558:       logger_, *clock_, 3000, "Slope source is not valid. Using raw_pitch option as default");
559:     control_data.slope_angle = m_lpf_pitch->filter(raw_pitch);
560:   }
561: 
562:   updatePitchDebugValues(control_data.slope_angle, traj_pitch, raw_pitch);
563: 
564:   return control_data;
565: }

567: PidLongitudinalController::Motion PidLongitudinalController::calcEmergencyCtrlCmd(
568:   const double dt) const
569: {
570:   // These accelerations are without slope compensation
571:   const auto & p = m_emergency_state_params;
572:   const double vel =
573:     longitudinal_utils::applyDiffLimitFilter(p.vel, m_prev_raw_ctrl_cmd.vel, dt, p.acc);
574:   const double acc =
575:     longitudinal_utils::applyDiffLimitFilter(p.acc, m_prev_raw_ctrl_cmd.acc, dt, p.jerk);
576: 
577:   RCLCPP_ERROR_THROTTLE(
578:     logger_, *clock_, 3000, "[Emergency stop] vel: %3.3f, acc: %3.3f", vel, acc);
579: 
580:   return Motion{vel, acc};
581: }

583: void PidLongitudinalController::updateControlState(const ControlData & control_data)
584: {
585:   const double current_vel = control_data.current_motion.vel;
586:   const double current_acc = control_data.current_motion.acc;
587:   const double stop_dist = control_data.stop_dist;
588: 
589:   // flags for state transition
590:   const auto & p = m_state_transition_params;
591: 
592:   const bool departure_condition_from_stopping =
593:     stop_dist > p.drive_state_stop_dist + p.drive_state_offset_stop_dist;
594:   const bool departure_condition_from_stopped = stop_dist > p.drive_state_stop_dist;
595: 
596:   // NOTE: the same velocity threshold as motion_utils::searchZeroVelocity
597:   static constexpr double vel_epsilon = 1e-3;
598: 
599:   // Let vehicle start after the steering is converged for control accuracy
600:   const bool keep_stopped_condition = std::fabs(current_vel) < vel_epsilon &&
601:                                       m_enable_keep_stopped_until_steer_convergence &&
602:                                       !lateral_sync_data_.is_steer_converged;
603:   if (keep_stopped_condition) {
604:     auto marker = createDefaultMarker(
605:       "map", clock_->now(), "stop_reason", 0, Marker::TEXT_VIEW_FACING,
606:       createMarkerScale(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), createMarkerColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.999));
607:     marker.pose = tier4_autoware_utils::calcOffsetPose(
608:       m_current_kinematic_state.pose.pose, m_wheel_base + m_front_overhang,
609:       m_vehicle_width / 2 + 2.0, 1.5);
610:     marker.text = "steering not\nconverged";
611:     m_pub_stop_reason_marker->publish(marker);
612:   }
613: 
614:   const bool stopping_condition = stop_dist < p.stopping_state_stop_dist;
615: 
616:   const bool is_stopped = std::abs(current_vel) < p.stopped_state_entry_vel &&
617:                           std::abs(current_acc) < p.stopped_state_entry_acc;
618:   // Case where the ego slips in the opposite direction of the gear due to e.g. a slope is also
619:   // considered as a stop
620:   const bool is_not_running = [&]() {
621:     if (control_data.shift == Shift::Forward) {
622:       if (is_stopped || current_vel < 0.0) {
623:         // NOTE: Stopped or moving backward
624:         return true;
625:       }
626:     } else {
627:       if (is_stopped || 0.0 < current_vel) {
628:         // NOTE: Stopped or moving forward
629:         return true;
630:       }
631:     }
632:     return false;
633:   }();
634:   if (!is_not_running) {
635:     m_last_running_time = std::make_shared<rclcpp::Time>(clock_->now());
636:   }
637:   const bool stopped_condition =
638:     m_last_running_time
639:       ? (clock_->now() - *m_last_running_time).seconds() > p.stopped_state_entry_duration_time
640:       : false;
641: 
642:   // ==========================================================================================
643:   // NOTE: due to removeOverlapPoints() in getControlData() m_trajectory and
644:   // control_data.interpolated_traj have different size.
645:   // ==========================================================================================
646:   const double current_vel_cmd = std::fabs(
647:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points.at(control_data.nearest_idx).longitudinal_velocity_mps);
648:   const bool emergency_condition = m_enable_overshoot_emergency &&
649:                                    stop_dist < -p.emergency_state_overshoot_stop_dist &&
650:                                    current_vel_cmd < vel_epsilon;
651:   const bool has_nonzero_target_vel = std::abs(current_vel_cmd) > 1.0e-5;
652: 
653:   const auto changeState = [this](const auto s) {
654:     if (s != m_control_state) {
655:       RCLCPP_DEBUG_STREAM(
656:         logger_, "controller state changed: " << toStr(m_control_state) << " -> " << toStr(s));
657:     }
658:     m_control_state = s;
659:     return;
660:   };
661: 
662:   const auto debug_msg_once = [this](const auto & s) { RCLCPP_DEBUG_ONCE(logger_, "%s", s); };
663: 
664:   const bool is_under_control = m_current_operation_mode.is_autoware_control_enabled &&
665:                                 m_current_operation_mode.mode == OperationModeState::AUTONOMOUS;
666: 
667:   if (is_under_control != m_prev_vehicle_is_under_control) {
668:     m_prev_vehicle_is_under_control = is_under_control;
669:     m_under_control_starting_time =
670:       is_under_control ? std::make_shared<rclcpp::Time>(clock_->now()) : nullptr;
671:   }
672:   // transit state
673:   // in DRIVE state
674:   if (m_control_state == ControlState::DRIVE) {
675:     if (emergency_condition) {
676:       return changeState(ControlState::EMERGENCY);
677:     }
678:     if (!is_under_control && stopped_condition && keep_stopped_condition) {
679:       // NOTE: When the ego is stopped on manual driving, since the driving state may transit to
680:       //       autonomous, keep_stopped_condition should be checked.
681:       return changeState(ControlState::STOPPED);
682:     }
683: 
684:     if (m_enable_smooth_stop) {
685:       if (stopping_condition) {
686:         // predictions after input time delay
687:         const double pred_vel_in_target = control_data.state_after_delay.vel;
688:         const double pred_stop_dist =
689:           control_data.stop_dist -
690:           0.5 * (pred_vel_in_target + current_vel) * m_delay_compensation_time;
691:         m_smooth_stop.init(pred_vel_in_target, pred_stop_dist);
692:         return changeState(ControlState::STOPPING);
693:       }
694:     } else {
695:       if (stopped_condition && !departure_condition_from_stopped) {
696:         return changeState(ControlState::STOPPED);
697:       }
698:     }
699:     return;
700:   }
701: 
702:   // in STOPPING state
703:   if (m_control_state == ControlState::STOPPING) {
704:     if (emergency_condition) {
705:       return changeState(ControlState::EMERGENCY);
706:     }
707:     if (stopped_condition) {
708:       return changeState(ControlState::STOPPED);
709:     }
710: 
711:     if (departure_condition_from_stopping) {
712:       m_pid_vel.reset();
713:       m_lpf_vel_error->reset(0.0);
714:       // prevent the car from taking a long time to start to move
715:       m_prev_ctrl_cmd.acc = std::max(0.0, m_prev_ctrl_cmd.acc);
716:       return changeState(ControlState::DRIVE);
717:     }
718:     return;
719:   }
720: 
721:   // in STOPPED state
722:   if (m_control_state == ControlState::STOPPED) {
723:     // -- debug print --
724:     if (has_nonzero_target_vel && !departure_condition_from_stopped) {
725:       debug_msg_once("target speed > 0, but departure condition is not met. Keep STOPPED.");
726:     }
727:     if (has_nonzero_target_vel && keep_stopped_condition) {
728:       debug_msg_once("target speed > 0, but keep stop condition is met. Keep STOPPED.");
729:     }
730:     // ---------------
731: 
732:     if (keep_stopped_condition) {
733:       return changeState(ControlState::STOPPED);
734:     }
735:     if (departure_condition_from_stopped) {
736:       m_pid_vel.reset();
737:       m_lpf_vel_error->reset(0.0);
738:       // prevent the car from taking a long time to start to move
739:       m_prev_ctrl_cmd.acc = std::max(0.0, m_prev_ctrl_cmd.acc);
740:       return changeState(ControlState::DRIVE);
741:     }
742: 
743:     return;
744:   }
745: 
746:   // in EMERGENCY state
747:   if (m_control_state == ControlState::EMERGENCY) {
748:     if (stopped_condition) {
749:       return changeState(ControlState::STOPPED);
750:     }
751: 
752:     if (!emergency_condition) {
753:       if (!is_under_control) {
754:         // NOTE: On manual driving, no need stopping to exit the emergency.
755:         return changeState(ControlState::DRIVE);
756:       }
757:     }
758:     return;
759:   }
760: 
761:   RCLCPP_FATAL(logger_, "invalid state found.");
762:   return;
763: }

765: PidLongitudinalController::Motion PidLongitudinalController::calcCtrlCmd(
766:   const ControlData & control_data)
767: {
768:   const size_t target_idx = control_data.target_idx;
769: 
770:   // velocity and acceleration command
771:   Motion raw_ctrl_cmd{
772:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points.at(target_idx).longitudinal_velocity_mps,
773:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points.at(target_idx).acceleration_mps2};
774: 
775:   if (m_control_state == ControlState::DRIVE) {
776:     raw_ctrl_cmd.vel =
777:       control_data.interpolated_traj.points.at(control_data.target_idx).longitudinal_velocity_mps;
778:     raw_ctrl_cmd.acc = applyVelocityFeedback(control_data);
779:     raw_ctrl_cmd = keepBrakeBeforeStop(control_data, raw_ctrl_cmd, target_idx);
780: 
781:     RCLCPP_DEBUG(
782:       logger_,
783:       "[feedback control]  vel: %3.3f, acc: %3.3f, dt: %3.3f, v_curr: %3.3f, v_ref: %3.3f "
784:       "feedback_ctrl_cmd.ac: %3.3f",
785:       raw_ctrl_cmd.vel, raw_ctrl_cmd.acc, control_data.dt, control_data.current_motion.vel,
786:       control_data.interpolated_traj.points.at(control_data.target_idx).longitudinal_velocity_mps,
787:       raw_ctrl_cmd.acc);
788:   } else if (m_control_state == ControlState::STOPPING) {
789:     raw_ctrl_cmd.acc = m_smooth_stop.calculate(
790:       control_data.stop_dist, control_data.current_motion.vel, control_data.current_motion.acc,
791:       m_vel_hist, m_delay_compensation_time);
792:     raw_ctrl_cmd.vel = m_stopped_state_params.vel;
793: 
794:     RCLCPP_DEBUG(
795:       logger_, "[smooth stop]: Smooth stopping. vel: %3.3f, acc: %3.3f", raw_ctrl_cmd.vel,
796:       raw_ctrl_cmd.acc);
797:   } else if (m_control_state == ControlState::STOPPED) {
798:     // This acceleration is without slope compensation
799:     const auto & p = m_stopped_state_params;
800:     raw_ctrl_cmd.vel = p.vel;
801:     raw_ctrl_cmd.acc = longitudinal_utils::applyDiffLimitFilter(
802:       p.acc, m_prev_raw_ctrl_cmd.acc, control_data.dt, p.jerk);
803: 
804:     RCLCPP_DEBUG(logger_, "[Stopped]. vel: %3.3f, acc: %3.3f", raw_ctrl_cmd.vel, raw_ctrl_cmd.acc);
805:   } else if (m_control_state == ControlState::EMERGENCY) {
806:     raw_ctrl_cmd = calcEmergencyCtrlCmd(control_data.dt);
807:   }
808: 
809:   // store acceleration without slope compensation
810:   m_prev_raw_ctrl_cmd = raw_ctrl_cmd;
811: 
812:   // apply slope compensation and filter acceleration and jerk
813:   const double filtered_acc_cmd = calcFilteredAcc(raw_ctrl_cmd.acc, control_data);
814:   const Motion filtered_ctrl_cmd{raw_ctrl_cmd.vel, filtered_acc_cmd};
815: 
816:   // update debug visualization
817:   updateDebugVelAcc(control_data);
818: 
819:   return filtered_ctrl_cmd;
820: }

822: // Do not use nearest_idx here
823: autoware_auto_control_msgs::msg::LongitudinalCommand PidLongitudinalController::createCtrlCmdMsg(
824:   const Motion & ctrl_cmd, const double & current_vel)
825: {
826:   // publish control command
827:   autoware_auto_control_msgs::msg::LongitudinalCommand cmd{};
828:   cmd.stamp = clock_->now();
829:   cmd.speed = static_cast<decltype(cmd.speed)>(ctrl_cmd.vel);
830:   cmd.acceleration = static_cast<decltype(cmd.acceleration)>(ctrl_cmd.acc);
831: 
832:   // store current velocity history
833:   m_vel_hist.push_back({clock_->now(), current_vel});
834:   while (m_vel_hist.size() >
835:          static_cast<size_t>(m_delay_compensation_time / m_longitudinal_ctrl_period)) {
836:     m_vel_hist.erase(m_vel_hist.begin());
837:   }
838: 
839:   m_prev_ctrl_cmd = ctrl_cmd;
840: 
841:   return cmd;
842: }

844: void PidLongitudinalController::publishDebugData(
845:   const Motion & ctrl_cmd, const ControlData & control_data)
846: {
847:   // set debug values
848:   m_debug_values.setValues(DebugValues::TYPE::DT, control_data.dt);
849:   m_debug_values.setValues(DebugValues::TYPE::CALCULATED_ACC, control_data.current_motion.acc);
850:   m_debug_values.setValues(DebugValues::TYPE::SHIFT, static_cast<double>(control_data.shift));
851:   m_debug_values.setValues(DebugValues::TYPE::STOP_DIST, control_data.stop_dist);
852:   m_debug_values.setValues(DebugValues::TYPE::CONTROL_STATE, static_cast<double>(m_control_state));
853:   m_debug_values.setValues(DebugValues::TYPE::ACC_CMD_PUBLISHED, ctrl_cmd.acc);
854: 
855:   // publish debug values
856:   tier4_debug_msgs::msg::Float32MultiArrayStamped debug_msg{};

949: double PidLongitudinalController::applySlopeCompensation(
950:   const double input_acc, const double pitch, const Shift shift) const
951: {
952:   if (!m_enable_slope_compensation) {
953:     return input_acc;
954:   }
955:   const double pitch_limited = std::min(std::max(pitch, m_min_pitch_rad), m_max_pitch_rad);

957:   // Acceleration command is always positive independent of direction (= shift) when car is running
958:   double sign = (shift == Shift::Forward) ? 1.0 : (shift == Shift::Reverse ? -1.0 : 0);
959:   double compensated_acc = input_acc + sign * 9.81 * std::sin(pitch_limited);
960:   return compensated_acc;

981:     const auto ui = static_cast<size_t>(i);
982:     if (traj.points.at(ui).acceleration_mps2 > static_cast<float>(min_acc_before_stop)) {
983:       break;

985:     min_acc_before_stop = traj.points.at(ui).acceleration_mps2;
986:     min_acc_idx = ui;

1011: PidLongitudinalController::StateAfterDelay PidLongitudinalController::predictedStateAfterDelay(
1012:   const Motion current_motion, const double delay_compensation_time) const
1013: {
1014:   const double current_vel = current_motion.vel;
1015:   const double current_acc = current_motion.acc;
1016:   double running_distance = 0.0;
1017:   double pred_vel = current_vel;
1018:   double pred_acc = current_acc;
1019: 
1020:   if (m_ctrl_cmd_vec.empty() || m_current_operation_mode.mode != OperationModeState::AUTONOMOUS) {
1021:     // check time to stop
1022:     const double time_to_stop = -current_vel / current_acc;
1023:     const double delay_time_calculation =
1024:       time_to_stop > 0.0 && time_to_stop < delay_compensation_time ? time_to_stop
1025:                                                                    : delay_compensation_time;
1026:     // simple linear prediction
1027:     pred_vel = current_vel + current_acc * delay_time_calculation;
1028:     running_distance = std::abs(
1029:       delay_time_calculation * current_vel +
1030:       0.5 * current_acc * delay_time_calculation * delay_time_calculation);
1031:     // avoid to change sign of current_vel and pred_vel
1032:     return StateAfterDelay{pred_vel, pred_acc, running_distance};
1033:   }
1034: 
1035:   for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_ctrl_cmd_vec.size(); ++i) {
1036:     if ((clock_->now() - m_ctrl_cmd_vec.at(i).stamp).seconds() < delay_compensation_time) {
1037:       // add velocity to accel * dt
1038:       const double time_to_next_acc =
1039:         (i == m_ctrl_cmd_vec.size() - 1)
1040:           ? std::min(
1041:               (clock_->now() - m_ctrl_cmd_vec.back().stamp).seconds(), delay_compensation_time)
1042:           : std::min(
1043:               (rclcpp::Time(m_ctrl_cmd_vec.at(i + 1).stamp) -
1044:                rclcpp::Time(m_ctrl_cmd_vec.at(i).stamp))
1045:                 .seconds(),
1046:               delay_compensation_time);
1047:       const double acc = m_ctrl_cmd_vec.at(i).acceleration;
1048:       // because acc_cmd is positive when vehicle is running backward
1049:       pred_acc = std::copysignf(1.0, static_cast<float>(pred_vel)) * acc;
1050:       running_distance += std::abs(
1051:         std::abs(pred_vel) * time_to_next_acc + 0.5 * acc * time_to_next_acc * time_to_next_acc);
1052:       pred_vel += pred_vel < 0.0 ? (-acc * time_to_next_acc) : (acc * time_to_next_acc);
1053:       if (pred_vel / current_vel < 0.0) {
1054:         // sign of velocity is changed
1055:         pred_vel = 0.0;
1056:         break;
1057:       }
1058:     }
1059:   }
1060: 
1061:   return StateAfterDelay{pred_vel, pred_acc, running_distance};
1062: }

1073:     control_data.interpolated_traj.points.at(control_data.target_idx).acceleration_mps2};

1075:   const bool is_under_control = m_current_operation_mode.is_autoware_control_enabled &&
1076:                                 m_current_operation_mode.mode == OperationModeState::AUTONOMOUS;

40: #### FeedForward (FF)
41: 
42: The reference acceleration set in the trajectory and slope compensation terms are output as a feedforward. Under ideal conditions with no modeling error, this FF term alone should be sufficient for velocity tracking.
43: 
44: Tracking errors causing modeling or discretization errors are removed by the feedback control (now using PID).
45: 
46: ##### Brake keeping
47: 
48: From the viewpoint of ride comfort, stopping with 0 acceleration is important because it reduces the impact of braking. However, if the target acceleration when stopping is 0, the vehicle may cross over the stop line or accelerate a little in front of the stop line due to vehicle model error or gradient estimation error.
49: 
50: For reliable stopping, the target acceleration calculated by the FeedForward system is limited to a negative acceleration when stopping.
51: 
52: ![BrakeKeepingDiagram](./media/BrakeKeeping.drawio.svg)
53: 
54: #### Slope compensation
55: 
56: Based on the slope information, a compensation term is added to the target acceleration.
57: 
58: There are two sources of the slope information, which can be switched by a parameter.
59: 
60: - Pitch of the estimated ego-pose (default)
61:   - Calculates the current slope from the pitch angle of the estimated ego-pose
62:   - Pros: Easily available
63:   - Cons: Cannot extract accurate slope information due to the influence of vehicle vibration.
64: - Z coordinate on the trajectory
65:   - Calculates the road slope from the difference of z-coordinates between the front and rear wheel positions in the target trajectory
66:   - Pros: More accurate than pitch information, if the z-coordinates of the route are properly maintained
67:   - Pros: Can be used in combination with delay compensation (not yet implemented)
68:   - Cons: z-coordinates of high-precision map is needed.
69:   - Cons: Does not support free space planning (for now)
70: 
71: **Notation:** This function works correctly only in a vehicle system that does not have acceleration feedback in the low-level control system.
72: 
73: This compensation adds gravity correction to the target acceleration, resulting in an output value that is no longer equal to the target acceleration that the autonomous driving system desires. Therefore, it conflicts with the role of the acceleration feedback in the low-level controller.
74: For instance, if the vehicle is attempting to start with an acceleration of `1.0 m/s^2` and a gravity correction of `-1.0 m/s^2` is applied, the output value will be `0`. If this output value is mistakenly treated as the target acceleration, the vehicle will not start.
75: 
76: A suitable example of a vehicle system for the slope compensation function is one in which the output acceleration from the longitudinal_controller is converted into target accel/brake pedal input without any feedbacks. In this case, the output acceleration is just used as a feedforward term to calculate the target pedal, and hence the issue mentioned above does not arise.
77: 
78: Note: The angle of the slope is defined as positive for an uphill slope, while the pitch angle of the ego pose is defined as negative when facing upward. They have an opposite definition.
79: 
80: ![slope_definition](./media/slope_definition.drawio.svg)
81: 
82: #### PID control
83: 
84: For deviations that cannot be handled by FeedForward control, such as model errors, PID control is used to construct a feedback system.
85: 
86: This PID control calculates the target acceleration from the deviation between the current ego-velocity and the target velocity.
87: 
88: This PID logic has a maximum value for the output of each term. This is to prevent the following:
89: 
90: - Large integral terms may cause unintended behavior by users.
91: - Unintended noise may cause the output of the derivative term to be very large.
92: 
93: Note: by default, the integral term in the control system is not accumulated when the vehicle is stationary. This precautionary measure aims to prevent unintended accumulation of the integral term in scenarios where Autoware assumes the vehicle is engaged, but an external system has immobilized the vehicle to initiate startup procedures.
94: 
95: However, certain situations may arise, such as when the vehicle encounters a depression in the road surface during startup or if the slope compensation is inaccurately estimated (lower than necessary), leading to a failure to initiate motion. To address these scenarios, it is possible to activate error integration even when the vehicle is at rest by setting the `enable_integration_at_low_speed` parameter to true.
96: 
97: When `enable_integration_at_low_speed` is set to true, the PID controller will initiate integration of the acceleration error after a specified duration defined by the `time_threshold_before_pid_integration` parameter has elapsed without the vehicle surpassing a minimum velocity set by the `current_vel_threshold_pid_integration` parameter.
98: 
99: The presence of the `time_threshold_before_pid_integration` parameter is important for practical PID tuning. Integrating the error when the vehicle is stationary or at low speed can complicate PID tuning. This parameter effectively introduces a delay before the integral part becomes active, preventing it from kicking in immediately. This delay allows for more controlled and effective tuning of the PID controller.
100: 
101: At present, PID control is implemented from the viewpoint of trade-off between development/maintenance cost and performance.
102: This may be replaced by a higher performance controller (adaptive control or robust control) in future development.

106: At high speeds, the delay of actuator systems such as gas pedals and brakes has a significant impact on driving accuracy.

The current `ndt_scan_matcher` publishes a single aggregated diagnostics message on the `/diagnostics` topic. This monolithic message combines all internal state into one `DiagnosticStatus`, making it difficult to reason about the health of individual subsystems (scan matching, map update, service handling, etc.).

    We need to refactor the diagnostics output to distribute the state into six separate, focused `DiagnosticStatus` messages, each with its own keys and documented transition conditions for WARN/ERROR levels:

    1. `scan_matching_status` — covers the main NDT scan matching pipeline.
    2. `initial_pose_subscriber_status` — covers the `ekf_pose_with_covariance` subscriber.
    3. `regularization_pose_subscriber_status` — covers the regularization pose subscriber (only active when regularization is enabled).
    4. `trigger_node_service_status` — covers the `trigger_node_srv` service.
    5. `ndt_align_service_status` — covers the `ndt_align_srv` service and associated map update.
    6. `map_update_status` — covers the periodic dynamic map update timer callback.

    The diagnostics should be generated by a dedicated `DiagnosticsModule` class that wraps the creation and publishing of a single `DiagnosticStatus` message. Each module instance should be owned by the relevant subsystem (e.g., map update module publishes `map_update_status`, core node publishes the others).

    The key conditions that should produce WARN or ERROR are specified in the README. For example, the map update module should raise an ERROR when the vehicle moves beyond the loaded map radius (`distance_last_update_position_to_current_position + lidar_radius > map_radius`), and a WARN when the node is not activated or no update position is available.

    Additionally, any invalid parameter configuration that previously produced a throttled warning (e.g., mismatched covariance estimation offset model sizes) should now throw at node construction to fail fast.

## Environment Setup
The main build configuration for this node is in `localization/ndt_scan_matcher/CMakeLists.txt`. It uses `ament_auto_add_executable` and `ament_auto_add_gtest`; check the `BUILD_TESTING` section for how tests are wired up. The package uses `find_package(autoware_cmake)` and `autoware_package()`, so standard Autoware build tooling applies. No separate `pyproject.toml` or `tox.ini` is present for this package.

## Implementation Plan
1.  **Create `DiagnosticsModule` class**:
        - New files: `include/ndt_scan_matcher/diagnostics_module.hpp` and `src/diagnostics_module.cpp`.
        - Constructor takes `rclcpp::Node*` and a diagnostic name string; sets up a publisher on `/diagnostics` and initializes the status message name as `<node_name>: <diagnostic_name>`.
        - Implement members:
          - `clear()` — reset the status message (keys, level, message).
          - `addKeyValue(key, value)` — append/update a key-value pair; templated overloads for numeric, `std::string`, and `bool` types.
          - `updateLevelAndMessage(level, message)` — accumulate WARN/ERROR messages and raise the status level if needed.
          - `publish()` — publish the current status.
    2.  **Wire into `NDTScanMatcher` core**:
        - In `include/ndt_scan_matcher/ndt_scan_matcher_core.hpp`, add `#include "ndt_scan_matcher/diagnostics_module.hpp"` and declare `std::unique_ptr<DiagnosticsModule>` members for:
          - `diagnostics_scan_points_`
          - `diagnostics_initial_pose_`
          - `diagnostics_map_update_`
          - `diagnostics_ndt_align_`
          - `diagnostics_trigger_node_`
        - In `src/ndt_scan_matcher_core.cpp`:
          - Remove the old `publish_diagnostic()` method and the `state_ptr_` map member.
          - Initialize the modules in the constructor (after `param_` is available).
          - Refactor callback bodies (`callback_sensor_points`, `callback_initial_pose`, `service_trigger_node`, `service_ndt_align`) to populate and publish the corresponding diagnostics module.
          - For `callback_timer()`, delegate map update logic to `MapUpdateModule` and have it use the passed-in `diagnostics_ptr`.
    3.  **Refactor `MapUpdateModule`**:
        - In `include/ndt_scan_matcher/map_update_module.hpp`, modify public/private API:
          - `callback_timer(is_activated, position, diagnostics_ptr)` — the new entry point from the core node's timer; checks activation, position availability, and calls `should_update_map` / `update_map`.
          - `should_update_map(position, diagnostics_ptr)` — update to take diagnostics pointer and record `distance_last_update_position_to_current_position`; raise ERROR when dynamic map loading lags.
          - `update_map(position, diagnostics_ptr)` — accept diagnostics pointer; record `is_need_rebuild`, `is_updated_map`, and other relevant fields.
          - `update_ndt(position, ndt, diagnostics_ptr)` — accept diagnostics pointer; record map-to-add/remove sizes and execution time.
        - Move the diagnostics-related logic from the core node into these methods.
    4.  **Update `HyperParameters` error handling**:

\end{align} 128: $$ 129: 130: Regularization is disabled by default. 131: If you wish to use it, please edit the following parameters to enable it. 132: 133: #### Where is regularization available 215: void NDTScanMatcher::callback_initial_pose_main(
216:   const geometry_msgs::msg::PoseWithCovarianceStamped::ConstSharedPtr initial_pose_msg_ptr)
217: {
218:   diagnostics_initial_pose_->addKeyValue(
219:     "topic_time_stamp", static_cast<rclcpp::Time>(initial_pose_msg_ptr->header.stamp).seconds());
220: 
221:   // check is_activated
222:   diagnostics_initial_pose_->addKeyValue("is_activated", static_cast<bool>(is_activated_));
223:   if (!is_activated_) {
224:     std::stringstream message;
225:     message << "Node is not activated.";
226:     diagnostics_initial_pose_->updateLevelAndMessage(
227:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
228:     return;
229:   }
230: 
231:   // check is_expected_frame_id
232:   const bool is_expected_frame_id =
233:     (initial_pose_msg_ptr->header.frame_id == param_.frame.map_frame);
234:   diagnostics_initial_pose_->addKeyValue("is_expected_frame_id", is_expected_frame_id);
235:   if (!is_expected_frame_id) {
236:     std::stringstream message;
237:     message << "Received initial pose message with frame_id "
238:             << initial_pose_msg_ptr->header.frame_id << ", but expected " << param_.frame.map_frame
239:             << ". Please check the frame_id in the input topic and ensure it is correct.";
240:     diagnostics_initial_pose_->updateLevelAndMessage(
241:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::ERROR, message.str());
242:     return;
243:   }
244: 
245:   initial_pose_buffer_->push_back(initial_pose_msg_ptr);
246: 
247:   {
248:     // latest_ekf_position_ is also used by callback_timer, so it is necessary to acquire the lock
249:     std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(latest_ekf_position_mtx_);
250:     latest_ekf_position_ = initial_pose_msg_ptr->pose.pose.position;
251:   }
252: }

292: bool NDTScanMatcher::callback_sensor_points_main(
293:   sensor_msgs::msg::PointCloud2::ConstSharedPtr sensor_points_msg_in_sensor_frame)
294: {
295:   const auto exe_start_time = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
296: 
297:   // check topic_time_stamp
298:   const rclcpp::Time sensor_ros_time = sensor_points_msg_in_sensor_frame->header.stamp;
299:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("topic_time_stamp", sensor_ros_time.seconds());
300: 
301:   // check sensor_points_size
302:   const size_t sensor_points_size = sensor_points_msg_in_sensor_frame->width;
303:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("sensor_points_size", sensor_points_size);
304:   if (sensor_points_size == 0) {
305:     std::stringstream message;
306:     message << "Sensor points is empty.";
307:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
308:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
309:     return false;
310:   }
311: 
312:   // check sensor_points_delay_time_sec
313:   const double sensor_points_delay_time_sec =
314:     (this->now() - sensor_points_msg_in_sensor_frame->header.stamp).seconds();
315:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue(
316:     "sensor_points_delay_time_sec", sensor_points_delay_time_sec);
317:   if (sensor_points_delay_time_sec > param_.validation.lidar_topic_timeout_sec) {
318:     std::stringstream message;
319:     message << "sensor points is experiencing latency."
320:             << "The delay time is " << sensor_points_delay_time_sec << "[sec] "
321:             << "(the tolerance is " << param_.validation.lidar_topic_timeout_sec << "[sec]).";
322:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
323:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
324: 
325:     // If the delay time of the LiDAR topic exceeds the delay compensation time of ekf_localizer,
326:     // even if further processing continues, the estimated result will be rejected by ekf_localizer.
327:     // Therefore, it would be acceptable to exit the function here.
328:     // However, for now, we will continue the processing as it is.
329: 
330:     // return false;
331:   }
332: 
333:   // preprocess input pointcloud
334:   pcl::shared_ptr<pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>> sensor_points_in_sensor_frame(
335:     new pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>);
336:   pcl::shared_ptr<pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>> sensor_points_in_baselink_frame(
337:     new pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>);
338:   const std::string & sensor_frame = sensor_points_msg_in_sensor_frame->header.frame_id;
339: 
340:   pcl::fromROSMsg(*sensor_points_msg_in_sensor_frame, *sensor_points_in_sensor_frame);
341: 
342:   // transform sensor points from sensor-frame to base_link
343:   try {
344:     transform_sensor_measurement(
345:       sensor_frame, param_.frame.base_frame, sensor_points_in_sensor_frame,
346:       sensor_points_in_baselink_frame);
347:   } catch (const std::exception & ex) {
348:     std::stringstream message;
349:     message << ex.what() << ". Please publish TF " << sensor_frame << " to "
350:             << param_.frame.base_frame;
351:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
352:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::ERROR, message.str());
353:     RCLCPP_ERROR_STREAM_THROTTLE(this->get_logger(), *this->get_clock(), 1000, message.str());
354:     diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("is_succeed_transform_sensor_points", false);
355:     return false;
356:   }
357:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("is_succeed_transform_sensor_points", true);
358: 
359:   // check sensor_points_max_distance
360:   double max_distance = 0.0;
361:   for (const auto & point : sensor_points_in_baselink_frame->points) {
362:     const double distance = std::hypot(point.x, point.y, point.z);
363:     max_distance = std::max(max_distance, distance);
364:   }
365: 
366:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("sensor_points_max_distance", max_distance);
367:   if (max_distance < param_.sensor_points.required_distance) {
368:     std::stringstream message;
369:     message << "Max distance of sensor points = " << std::fixed << std::setprecision(3)
370:             << max_distance << " [m] < " << param_.sensor_points.required_distance << " [m]";
371:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
372:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
373:     return false;
374:   }
375: 
376:   // lock mutex
377:   std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(ndt_ptr_mtx_);
378: 
379:   // set sensor points to ndt class
380:   ndt_ptr_->setInputSource(sensor_points_in_baselink_frame);
381: 
382:   // check is_activated
383:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("is_activated", static_cast<bool>(is_activated_));
384:   if (!is_activated_) {
385:     std::stringstream message;
386:     message << "Node is not activated.";
387:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
388:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
389:     return false;
390:   }
391: 
392:   // calculate initial pose
393:   std::optional<SmartPoseBuffer::InterpolateResult> interpolation_result_opt =
394:     initial_pose_buffer_->interpolate(sensor_ros_time);
395: 
396:   // check is_succeed_interpolate_initial_pose
397:   const bool is_succeed_interpolate_initial_pose = (interpolation_result_opt != std::nullopt);
398:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue(
399:     "is_succeed_interpolate_initial_pose", is_succeed_interpolate_initial_pose);
400:   if (!is_succeed_interpolate_initial_pose) {
401:     std::stringstream message;
402:     message << "Couldn't interpolate pose. Please check the initial pose topic";
403:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
404:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
405:     return false;
406:   }
407: 
408:   initial_pose_buffer_->pop_old(sensor_ros_time);
409:   const SmartPoseBuffer::InterpolateResult & interpolation_result =
410:     interpolation_result_opt.value();
411: 
412:   // if regularization is enabled and available, set pose to NDT for regularization
413:   if (param_.ndt_regularization_enable) {
414:     add_regularization_pose(sensor_ros_time);
415:   }
416: 
417:   // check is_set_map_points
418:   const bool is_set_map_points = (ndt_ptr_->getInputTarget() != nullptr);
419:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("is_set_map_points", is_set_map_points);
420:   if (!is_set_map_points) {
421:     std::stringstream message;
422:     message << "Map points is not set.";
423:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
424:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
425:     return false;
426:   }
427: 
428:   // perform ndt scan matching
429:   const Eigen::Matrix4f initial_pose_matrix =
430:     pose_to_matrix4f(interpolation_result.interpolated_pose.pose.pose);
431:   auto output_cloud = std::make_shared<pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>>();
432:   ndt_ptr_->align(*output_cloud, initial_pose_matrix);
433:   const pclomp::NdtResult ndt_result = ndt_ptr_->getResult();
434: 
435:   const geometry_msgs::msg::Pose result_pose_msg = matrix4f_to_pose(ndt_result.pose);
436:   std::vector<geometry_msgs::msg::Pose> transformation_msg_array;
437:   for (const auto & pose_matrix : ndt_result.transformation_array) {
438:     geometry_msgs::msg::Pose pose_ros = matrix4f_to_pose(pose_matrix);
439:     transformation_msg_array.push_back(pose_ros);
440:   }
441: 
442:   // check iteration_num
443:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("iteration_num", ndt_result.iteration_num);
444:   const bool is_ok_iteration_num = (ndt_result.iteration_num < ndt_ptr_->getMaximumIterations());
445:   if (!is_ok_iteration_num) {
446:     std::stringstream message;
447:     message << "The number of iterations has reached its upper limit. The number of iterations: "
448:             << ndt_result.iteration_num << ", Limit: " << ndt_ptr_->getMaximumIterations() << ".";
449:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
450:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
451:   }
452: 
453:   // check local_optimal_solution_oscillation_num
454:   constexpr int oscillation_num_threshold = 10;
455:   const int oscillation_num = count_oscillation(transformation_msg_array);
456:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("local_optimal_solution_oscillation_num", oscillation_num);
457:   const bool is_local_optimal_solution_oscillation = (oscillation_num > oscillation_num_threshold);
458:   if (is_local_optimal_solution_oscillation) {
459:     std::stringstream message;
460:     message << "There is a possibility of oscillation in a local minimum";
461:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
462:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
463:   }
464: 
465:   // check score
466:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("transform_probability", ndt_result.transform_probability);
467:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue(
468:     "nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood", ndt_result.nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood);
469:   std::string score_name = "";
470:   double score = 0.0;
471:   double score_threshold = 0.0;
472:   if (param_.score_estimation.converged_param_type == ConvergedParamType::TRANSFORM_PROBABILITY) {
473:     score_name = "Transform Probability";
474:     score = ndt_result.transform_probability;
475:     score_threshold = param_.score_estimation.converged_param_transform_probability;
476:   } else if (
477:     param_.score_estimation.converged_param_type ==
478:     ConvergedParamType::NEAREST_VOXEL_TRANSFORMATION_LIKELIHOOD) {
479:     score_name = "Nearest Voxel Transformation Likelihood";
480:     score = ndt_result.nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood;
481:     score_threshold =
482:       param_.score_estimation.converged_param_nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood;
483:   } else {
484:     std::stringstream message;
485:     message << "Unknown converged param type. Please check `score_estimation.converged_param_type`";
486:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
487:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::ERROR, message.str());
488:     return false;
489:   }
490: 
491:   bool is_ok_score = (score > score_threshold);
492:   if (!is_ok_score) {
493:     std::stringstream message;
494:     message << "Score is below the threshold. Score: " << score
495:             << ", Threshold: " << score_threshold;
496:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
497:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
498:     RCLCPP_WARN_STREAM(this->get_logger(), message.str());
499:   }
500: 
501:   // check is_converged
502:   bool is_converged = (is_ok_iteration_num || is_local_optimal_solution_oscillation) && is_ok_score;
503: 
504:   // covariance estimation
505:   const Eigen::Quaterniond map_to_base_link_quat = Eigen::Quaterniond(
506:     result_pose_msg.orientation.w, result_pose_msg.orientation.x, result_pose_msg.orientation.y,
507:     result_pose_msg.orientation.z);
508:   const Eigen::Matrix3d map_to_base_link_rotation =
509:     map_to_base_link_quat.normalized().toRotationMatrix();
510: 
511:   std::array<double, 36> ndt_covariance =
512:     rotate_covariance(param_.covariance.output_pose_covariance, map_to_base_link_rotation);
513: 
514:   if (is_converged && param_.covariance.covariance_estimation.enable) {
515:     const auto estimated_covariance =
516:       estimate_covariance(ndt_result, initial_pose_matrix, sensor_ros_time);
517:     ndt_covariance = estimated_covariance;
518:   }
519: 
520:   // check distance_initial_to_result
521:   const auto distance_initial_to_result = static_cast<double>(
522:     norm(interpolation_result.interpolated_pose.pose.pose.position, result_pose_msg.position));
523:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("distance_initial_to_result", distance_initial_to_result);
524:   const double warn_distance_initial_to_result = 3.0;
525:   if (distance_initial_to_result > warn_distance_initial_to_result) {
526:     std::stringstream message;
527:     message << "distance_initial_to_result is too large (" << distance_initial_to_result
528:             << " [m]).";
529:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
530:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
531:   }
532: 
533:   // check execution_time
534:   const auto exe_end_time = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
535:   const auto duration_micro_sec =
536:     std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(exe_end_time - exe_start_time).count();
537:   const auto exe_time = static_cast<float>(duration_micro_sec) / 1000.0f;
538:   diagnostics_scan_points_->addKeyValue("execution_time", exe_time);
539:   if (exe_time > param_.validation.critical_upper_bound_exe_time_ms) {
540:     std::stringstream message;
541:     message << "NDT exe time is too long (took " << exe_time << " [ms]).";
542:     diagnostics_scan_points_->updateLevelAndMessage(
543:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
544:   }
545: 
546:   // publish
547:   initial_pose_with_covariance_pub_->publish(interpolation_result.interpolated_pose);
548:   exe_time_pub_->publish(make_float32_stamped(sensor_ros_time, exe_time));
549:   transform_probability_pub_->publish(
550:     make_float32_stamped(sensor_ros_time, ndt_result.transform_probability));
551:   nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood_pub_->publish(
552:     make_float32_stamped(sensor_ros_time, ndt_result.nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood));
553:   iteration_num_pub_->publish(make_int32_stamped(sensor_ros_time, ndt_result.iteration_num));
554:   publish_tf(sensor_ros_time, result_pose_msg);
555:   publish_pose(sensor_ros_time, result_pose_msg, ndt_covariance, is_converged);
556:   publish_marker(sensor_ros_time, transformation_msg_array);
557:   publish_initial_to_result(
558:     sensor_ros_time, result_pose_msg, interpolation_result.interpolated_pose,
559:     interpolation_result.old_pose, interpolation_result.new_pose);
560: 
561:   pcl::shared_ptr<pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>> sensor_points_in_map_ptr(
562:     new pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>);
563:   tier4_autoware_utils::transformPointCloud(
564:     *sensor_points_in_baselink_frame, *sensor_points_in_map_ptr, ndt_result.pose);
565:   publish_point_cloud(sensor_ros_time, param_.frame.map_frame, sensor_points_in_map_ptr);
566: 
567:   // whether use no ground points to calculate score
568:   if (param_.score_estimation.no_ground_points.enable) {
569:     // remove ground
570:     pcl::shared_ptr<pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>> no_ground_points_in_map_ptr(
571:       new pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>);
572:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sensor_points_in_map_ptr->size(); i++) {
573:       const float point_z = sensor_points_in_map_ptr->points[i].z;  // NOLINT
574:       if (
575:         point_z - matrix4f_to_pose(ndt_result.pose).position.z >
576:         param_.score_estimation.no_ground_points.z_margin_for_ground_removal) {
577:         no_ground_points_in_map_ptr->points.push_back(sensor_points_in_map_ptr->points[i]);
578:       }
579:     }
580:     // pub remove-ground points
581:     sensor_msgs::msg::PointCloud2 no_ground_points_msg_in_map;
582:     pcl::toROSMsg(*no_ground_points_in_map_ptr, no_ground_points_msg_in_map);
583:     no_ground_points_msg_in_map.header.stamp = sensor_ros_time;
584:     no_ground_points_msg_in_map.header.frame_id = param_.frame.map_frame;
585:     no_ground_points_aligned_pose_pub_->publish(no_ground_points_msg_in_map);
586:     // calculate score
587:     const auto no_ground_transform_probability = static_cast<float>(
588:       ndt_ptr_->calculateTransformationProbability(*no_ground_points_in_map_ptr));
589:     const auto no_ground_nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood = static_cast<float>(
590:       ndt_ptr_->calculateNearestVoxelTransformationLikelihood(*no_ground_points_in_map_ptr));
591:     // pub score
592:     no_ground_transform_probability_pub_->publish(
593:       make_float32_stamped(sensor_ros_time, no_ground_transform_probability));
594:     no_ground_nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood_pub_->publish(
595:       make_float32_stamped(sensor_ros_time, no_ground_nearest_voxel_transformation_likelihood));
596:   }
597: 
598:   return is_converged;
599: }

728: int NDTScanMatcher::count_oscillation(
729:   const std::vector<geometry_msgs::msg::Pose> & result_pose_msg_array)
730: {
731:   constexpr double inversion_vector_threshold = -0.9;
732: 
733:   int oscillation_cnt = 0;
734:   int max_oscillation_cnt = 0;
735: 
736:   for (size_t i = 2; i < result_pose_msg_array.size(); ++i) {
737:     const Eigen::Vector3d current_pose = point_to_vector3d(result_pose_msg_array.at(i).position);
738:     const Eigen::Vector3d prev_pose = point_to_vector3d(result_pose_msg_array.at(i - 1).position);
739:     const Eigen::Vector3d prev_prev_pose =
740:       point_to_vector3d(result_pose_msg_array.at(i - 2).position);
741:     const auto current_vec = (current_pose - prev_pose).normalized();
742:     const auto prev_vec = (prev_pose - prev_prev_pose).normalized();
743:     const double cosine_value = current_vec.dot(prev_vec);
744:     const bool oscillation = cosine_value < inversion_vector_threshold;
745:     if (oscillation) {
746:       oscillation_cnt++;  // count consecutive oscillation
747:     } else {
748:       oscillation_cnt = 0;  // reset
749:     }
750:     max_oscillation_cnt = std::max(max_oscillation_cnt, oscillation_cnt);
751:   }
752:   return max_oscillation_cnt;
753: }

755: std::array<double, 36> NDTScanMatcher::rotate_covariance(
756:   const std::array<double, 36> & src_covariance, const Eigen::Matrix3d & rotation) const
757: {
758:   std::array<double, 36> ret_covariance = src_covariance;
759: 
760:   Eigen::Matrix3d src_cov;
761:   src_cov << src_covariance[0], src_covariance[1], src_covariance[2], src_covariance[6],
762:     src_covariance[7], src_covariance[8], src_covariance[12], src_covariance[13],
763:     src_covariance[14];
764: 
765:   Eigen::Matrix3d ret_cov;
766:   ret_cov = rotation * src_cov * rotation.transpose();
767: 
768:   for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
769:     ret_covariance[i] = ret_cov(0, i);
770:     ret_covariance[i + 6] = ret_cov(1, i);
771:     ret_covariance[i + 12] = ret_cov(2, i);
772:   }
773: 
774:   return ret_covariance;
775: }

777: std::array<double, 36> NDTScanMatcher::estimate_covariance(
778:   const pclomp::NdtResult & ndt_result, const Eigen::Matrix4f & initial_pose_matrix,
779:   const rclcpp::Time & sensor_ros_time)
780: {
781:   Eigen::Matrix2d rot = Eigen::Matrix2d::Identity();
782:   try {
783:     rot = find_rotation_matrix_aligning_covariance_to_principal_axes(
784:       ndt_result.hessian.inverse().block(0, 0, 2, 2));
785:   } catch (const std::exception & e) {
786:     std::stringstream message;
787:     message << "Error in Eigen solver: " << e.what();
788:     RCLCPP_WARN_STREAM_THROTTLE(this->get_logger(), *this->get_clock(), 1000, message.str());
789: 
790:     return param_.covariance.output_pose_covariance;
791:   }
792: 
793:   // first result is added to mean
794:   const int n =
795:     static_cast<int>(param_.covariance.covariance_estimation.initial_pose_offset_model.size()) + 1;
796:   const Eigen::Vector2d ndt_pose_2d(ndt_result.pose(0, 3), ndt_result.pose(1, 3));
797:   Eigen::Vector2d mean = ndt_pose_2d;
798:   std::vector<Eigen::Vector2d> ndt_pose_2d_vec;
799:   ndt_pose_2d_vec.reserve(n);
800:   ndt_pose_2d_vec.emplace_back(ndt_pose_2d);
801: 
802:   geometry_msgs::msg::PoseArray multi_ndt_result_msg;
803:   geometry_msgs::msg::PoseArray multi_initial_pose_msg;
804:   multi_ndt_result_msg.header.stamp = sensor_ros_time;
805:   multi_ndt_result_msg.header.frame_id = param_.frame.map_frame;
806:   multi_initial_pose_msg.header.stamp = sensor_ros_time;
807:   multi_initial_pose_msg.header.frame_id = param_.frame.map_frame;
808:   multi_ndt_result_msg.poses.push_back(matrix4f_to_pose(ndt_result.pose));
809:   multi_initial_pose_msg.poses.push_back(matrix4f_to_pose(initial_pose_matrix));
810: 
811:   // multiple searches
812:   for (const auto & pose_offset :
813:        param_.covariance.covariance_estimation.initial_pose_offset_model) {
814:     const Eigen::Vector2d rotated_pose_offset_2d = rot * pose_offset;
815: 
816:     Eigen::Matrix4f sub_initial_pose_matrix(Eigen::Matrix4f::Identity());
817:     sub_initial_pose_matrix = ndt_result.pose;
818:     sub_initial_pose_matrix(0, 3) += static_cast<float>(rotated_pose_offset_2d.x());
819:     sub_initial_pose_matrix(1, 3) += static_cast<float>(rotated_pose_offset_2d.y());
820: 
821:     auto sub_output_cloud = std::make_shared<pcl::PointCloud<PointSource>>();
822:     ndt_ptr_->align(*sub_output_cloud, sub_initial_pose_matrix);
823:     const Eigen::Matrix4f sub_ndt_result = ndt_ptr_->getResult().pose;
824: 
825:     const Eigen::Vector2d sub_ndt_pose_2d = sub_ndt_result.topRightCorner<2, 1>().cast<double>();
826:     mean += sub_ndt_pose_2d;
827:     ndt_pose_2d_vec.emplace_back(sub_ndt_pose_2d);
828: 
829:     multi_ndt_result_msg.poses.push_back(matrix4f_to_pose(sub_ndt_result));
830:     multi_initial_pose_msg.poses.push_back(matrix4f_to_pose(sub_initial_pose_matrix));
831:   }
832: 
833:   // calculate the covariance matrix
834:   mean /= n;
835:   Eigen::Matrix2d pca_covariance = Eigen::Matrix2d::Zero();
836:   for (const auto & temp_ndt_pose_2d : ndt_pose_2d_vec) {
837:     const Eigen::Vector2d diff_2d = temp_ndt_pose_2d - mean;
838:     pca_covariance += diff_2d * diff_2d.transpose();
839:   }
840:   pca_covariance /= (n - 1);  // unbiased covariance
841: 
842:   std::array<double, 36> ndt_covariance = param_.covariance.output_pose_covariance;
843:   ndt_covariance[0 + 6 * 0] += pca_covariance(0, 0);
844:   ndt_covariance[1 + 6 * 0] += pca_covariance(1, 0);
845:   ndt_covariance[0 + 6 * 1] += pca_covariance(0, 1);
846:   ndt_covariance[1 + 6 * 1] += pca_covariance(1, 1);
847: 
848:   multi_ndt_pose_pub_->publish(multi_ndt_result_msg);
849:   multi_initial_pose_pub_->publish(multi_initial_pose_msg);
850: 
851:   return ndt_covariance;
852: }

908: void NDTScanMatcher::service_ndt_align_main(
909:   const tier4_localization_msgs::srv::PoseWithCovarianceStamped::Request::SharedPtr req,
910:   tier4_localization_msgs::srv::PoseWithCovarianceStamped::Response::SharedPtr res)
911: {
912:   diagnostics_ndt_align_->addKeyValue("service_call_time_stamp", this->now().seconds());
913: 
914:   // get TF from pose_frame to map_frame
915:   const std::string & target_frame = param_.frame.map_frame;
916:   const std::string & source_frame = req->pose_with_covariance.header.frame_id;
917: 
918:   geometry_msgs::msg::TransformStamped transform_s2t;
919:   try {
920:     transform_s2t = tf2_buffer_.lookupTransform(target_frame, source_frame, tf2::TimePointZero);
921:   } catch (tf2::TransformException & ex) {
922:     // Note: Up to AWSIMv1.1.0, there is a known bug where the GNSS frame_id is incorrectly set to
923:     // "gnss_link" instead of "map". The ndt_align is designed to return identity when this issue
924:     // occurs. However, in the future, converting to a non-existent frame_id should be prohibited.
925: 
926:     diagnostics_ndt_align_->addKeyValue("is_succeed_transform_initial_pose", false);
927: 
928:     std::stringstream message;
929:     message << "Please publish TF " << target_frame.c_str() << " to " << source_frame.c_str();
930:     diagnostics_ndt_align_->updateLevelAndMessage(
931:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::ERROR, message.str());
932:     RCLCPP_ERROR_STREAM_THROTTLE(this->get_logger(), *this->get_clock(), 1000, message.str());
933:     res->success = false;
934:     return;
935:   }
936:   diagnostics_ndt_align_->addKeyValue("is_succeed_transform_initial_pose", true);
937: 
938:   // transform pose_frame to map_frame
939:   const auto initial_pose_msg_in_map_frame = transform(req->pose_with_covariance, transform_s2t);
940:   map_update_module_->update_map(
941:     initial_pose_msg_in_map_frame.pose.pose.position, diagnostics_ndt_align_);
942: 
943:   // mutex Map
944:   std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(ndt_ptr_mtx_);
945: 
946:   // check is_set_map_points
947:   bool is_set_map_points = (ndt_ptr_->getInputTarget() != nullptr);
948:   diagnostics_ndt_align_->addKeyValue("is_set_map_points", is_set_map_points);
949:   if (!is_set_map_points) {
950:     std::stringstream message;
951:     message << "No InputTarget. Please check the map file and the map_loader service";
952:     diagnostics_ndt_align_->updateLevelAndMessage(
953:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
954:     RCLCPP_WARN_STREAM_THROTTLE(this->get_logger(), *this->get_clock(), 1000, message.str());
955:     res->success = false;
956:     return;
957:   }
958: 
959:   // check is_set_sensor_points
960:   bool is_set_sensor_points = (ndt_ptr_->getInputSource() != nullptr);
961:   diagnostics_ndt_align_->addKeyValue("is_set_sensor_points", is_set_sensor_points);
962:   if (!is_set_sensor_points) {
963:     std::stringstream message;
964:     message << "No InputSource. Please check the input lidar topic";
965:     diagnostics_ndt_align_->updateLevelAndMessage(
966:       diagnostic_msgs::msg::DiagnosticStatus::WARN, message.str());
967:     RCLCPP_WARN_STREAM_THROTTLE(this->get_logger(), *this->get_clock(), 1000, message.str());
968:     res->success = false;
969:     return;
970:   }
971: 
972:   res->pose_with_covariance = align_pose(initial_pose_msg_in_map_frame);
973:   res->success = true;
974:   res->pose_with_covariance.pose.covariance = req->pose_with_covariance.pose.covariance;
975: }

977: geometry_msgs::msg::PoseWithCovarianceStamped NDTScanMatcher::align_pose(
978:   const geometry_msgs::msg::PoseWithCovarianceStamped & initial_pose_with_cov)
979: {
980:   output_pose_with_cov_to_log(get_logger(), "align_pose_input", initial_pose_with_cov);
981: 
982:   const auto base_rpy = get_rpy(initial_pose_with_cov);
983:   const Eigen::Map<const RowMatrixXd> covariance = {
984:     initial_pose_with_cov.pose.covariance.data(), 6, 6};
985:   const double stddev_x = std::sqrt(covariance(0, 0));
986:   const double stddev_y = std::sqrt(covariance(1, 1));
987:   const double stddev_z = std::sqrt(covariance(2, 2));
988:   const double stddev_roll = std::sqrt(covariance(3, 3));
989:   const double stddev_pitch = std::sqrt(covariance(4, 4));
990: 
991:   // Let phi be the cumulative distribution function of the standard normal distribution.
992:   // It has the following relationship with the error function (erf).
993:   //   phi(x) = 1/2 (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2)))
994:   // so, 2 * phi(x) - 1 = erf(x / sqrt(2)).
995:   // The range taken by 2 * phi(x) - 1 is [-1, 1], so it can be used as a uniform distribution in
996:   // TPE. Let u = 2 * phi(x) - 1, then x = sqrt(2) * erf_inv(u). Computationally, it is not a good
997:   // to give erf_inv -1 and 1, so it is rounded off at (-1 + eps, 1 - eps).
998:   const double sqrt2 = std::sqrt(2);
999:   auto uniform_to_normal = [&sqrt2](const double uniform) {
1000:     assert(-1.0 <= uniform && uniform <= 1.0);
1001:     constexpr double epsilon = 1.0e-6;
1002:     const double clamped = std::clamp(uniform, -1.0 + epsilon, 1.0 - epsilon);
1003:     return boost::math::erf_inv(clamped) * sqrt2;
1004:   };
1005: 
1006:   auto normal_to_uniform = [&sqrt2](const double normal) {
1007:     return boost::math::erf(normal / sqrt2);
1008:   };
1009: 
1010:   // Optimizing (x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw) 6 dimensions.
1011:   // The last dimension (yaw) is a loop variable.
1012:   // Although roll and pitch are also angles, they are considered non-looping variables that follow
1013:   // a normal distribution with a small standard deviation. This assumes that the initial pose of

249: bool VehicleCmdGate::isHeartbeatTimeout(
250:   const std::shared_ptr<rclcpp::Time> & heartbeat_received_time, const double timeout)
251: {
252:   if (timeout == 0.0) {
253:     return false;
254:   }
255: 
256:   if (!heartbeat_received_time) {
257:     return true;
258:   }
259: 
260:   const auto time_from_heartbeat = this->now() - *heartbeat_received_time;
261: 
262:   return time_from_heartbeat.seconds() > timeout;
263: }

315: void VehicleCmdGate::onTimer()
316: {
317:   updater_.force_update();
318: 
319:   if (!isDataReady()) {
320:     RCLCPP_INFO_THROTTLE(get_logger(), *get_clock(), 5000, "waiting topics...");
321:     return;
322:   }
323: 
324:   // Check system emergency heartbeat
325:   if (use_emergency_handling_) {
326:     is_emergency_state_heartbeat_timeout_ = isHeartbeatTimeout(
327:       emergency_state_heartbeat_received_time_, system_emergency_heartbeat_timeout_);
328: 
329:     if (is_emergency_state_heartbeat_timeout_) {
330:       RCLCPP_WARN_THROTTLE(
331:         get_logger(), *get_clock(), 5000 /*ms*/, "system_emergency heartbeat is timeout.");
332:       publishEmergencyStopControlCommands();
333:       return;
334:     }
335:   }
336: 
337:   // Check external emergency stop heartbeat
338:   if (check_external_emergency_heartbeat_) {
339:     is_external_emergency_stop_heartbeat_timeout_ = isHeartbeatTimeout(
340:       external_emergency_stop_heartbeat_received_time_, external_emergency_stop_heartbeat_timeout_);
341: 
342:     if (is_external_emergency_stop_heartbeat_timeout_) {
343:       RCLCPP_WARN_THROTTLE(
344:         get_logger(), *get_clock(), 5000 /*ms*/, "external_emergency_stop heartbeat is timeout.");
345:       is_external_emergency_stop_ = true;
346:     }
347:   }
348: 
349:   // Check external emergency stop
350:   if (is_external_emergency_stop_) {
351:     if (!is_external_emergency_stop_heartbeat_timeout_) {
352:       RCLCPP_INFO_THROTTLE(
353:         get_logger(), *get_clock(), 5000 /*ms*/,
354:         "Please call `clear_external_emergency_stop` service to clear state.");
355:     }
356: 
357:     publishEmergencyStopControlCommands();
358:     return;
359:   }
360: 
361:   // Select commands
362:   TurnIndicatorsCommand turn_indicator;
363:   HazardLightsCommand hazard_light;
364:   GearCommand gear;
365:   if (use_emergency_handling_ && is_system_emergency_) {
366:     turn_indicator = emergency_commands_.turn_indicator;
367:     hazard_light = emergency_commands_.hazard_light;
368:     gear = emergency_commands_.gear;
369:   } else {
370:     if (current_gate_mode_.data == GateMode::AUTO) {
371:       turn_indicator = auto_commands_.turn_indicator;
372:       hazard_light = auto_commands_.hazard_light;
373:       gear = auto_commands_.gear;
374: 
375:       // Don't send turn signal when autoware is not engaged
376:       if (!is_engaged_) {
377:         turn_indicator.command = TurnIndicatorsCommand::NO_COMMAND;
378:         hazard_light.command = HazardLightsCommand::NO_COMMAND;
379:       }
380:     } else if (current_gate_mode_.data == GateMode::EXTERNAL) {
381:       turn_indicator = remote_commands_.turn_indicator;
382:       hazard_light = remote_commands_.hazard_light;
383:       gear = remote_commands_.gear;
384:     } else {
385:       throw std::runtime_error("invalid mode");
386:     }
387:   }
388: 
389:   // Publish topics
390:   turn_indicator_cmd_pub_->publish(turn_indicator);
391:   hazard_light_cmd_pub_->publish(hazard_light);
392:   gear_cmd_pub_->publish(gear);
393: }
